_comment: Maintained by Claude — see ../CLAUDE.md 'Dashboard Maintenance' rule. Status values: concept | in-progress | review | ready | archived. Keys in 'mocks' are folder paths relative to products/Scheduling/ (no trailing /index.html).

recentChanges.summary: Rule builder no longer skips follow-up sub-questions implied by an answer. For the two reset-based rules (Accumulation — Hours Based, Accumulating Rolodex), picking an option like 'Custom mix', 'Custom range', 'Both, weighted', or a 'Custom' limit now inserts the detail question it implies (e.g. which outcomes, what range, how to weight, what limit) before resuming the main flow exactly where it left off. Main question order is unchanged.

Applied AI-branding feedback: swapped the single-star sparkle for the company-standard 3-star AI icon everywhere it appears (~18 spots — AI assistant avatar, badges, Add New Rule button, empty states, etc.), and added the company-approved 'Powered by AI' phrasing to the rule-builder header and the AI Assistant card header.

Made the flow switcher auto-hide and reveal macOS Dock–style: it's tucked off the bottom edge by default (a faint grabber hints at it) and slides up when the user hovers or clicks the bottom-center reveal strip, then slides away shortly after the pointer leaves.

Expanded the bottom-center flow switcher from two options to three and relabeled them. New front/default 'Rules engine' flow lands the user straight inside the dual-screen rule builder (as if Add New Rule was just clicked). 'First setup' (was V1) is the fresh no-approaches onboarding, and 'Rule step' (was V2) is the approaches-created/create-first-rule state.

Fixed the guided rule-builder asking for approaches twice: now that approaches are the opening question, picking a ranking template (e.g. 'Accumulation — Hours Based') no longer re-asks 'Which approach(es) should this rule cover?' as the template's first question. The template's approaches step is skipped, its rule-intro line is grafted onto the next real question, and an 'Applies to: …' chip confirms the approaches already chosen. The duplicate is only suppressed when approaches were already answered (guided/seeded) — the describe-it-yourself and MOU paths still ask approaches normally.

In the rule builder's 'Describe it in my own words' path, the prepopulated starting-point suggestions are no longer shown up front — the user is prompted to write their own description first (with the spotlighted text box), and the suggestions appear only after they've written and sent that first description.

Renamed the rule builder's opening setup-mode chips for a friendlier, clearer voice: 'Guided setup' → 'Guide me step by step' and 'Give me a description' → 'Describe it in my own words' (intro line and routing logic updated to match). Choosing the describe option now spotlights the chat composer — the text box enlarges (4 rows), gets a purple highlight border + a brief glow pulse, and auto-focuses — so it's obvious that typing a description is the next step. The cue clears once the user sends.

Added a bottom-center V1/V2 flow switcher to Approaches & Rules: V1 is a fresh account with no approaches (purple dotted 'create your first approach' empty-state, Rules shown as quiet plain text, setup stepper on 'Create approaches'); V2 is the existing 'approaches made, create your first rule' state. The '+ Add New Approach' button opens a faithful reproduction of the production 'Create new Approach' screen (name field, LIST/GROUP/SPECIALTY/QUALIFER/SENIORITY categories, Options toggles, dark 'selected users' rail) — Save is the only live action and makes the approach appear with a 'New' badge, advancing the page into the V2 state.
Added a file-attaching feature below the chat text input: an 'Attach files' affordance opens a file picker and selected files show as removable chips with name and size.

Clicking an assigned person on the day view now opens the production edit-shift modal (project code / work type / shift + break times / labels / notes / repeating pattern / count-towards-approach, with the Save and Delete footer on one line). When that person has a concurrent shift, it shows at the top of the modal — between the name and the form fields — as a compact block (no box): the orange flag + event type (e.g. 'TargetSolutions event') on the first line, then the bold assignment name + plain time range beneath, mirroring the hover-card order.

Preview Mode now builds on the callback chain when the shift start date moves forward (editing the date or the new +1 day / +1 week jumps no longer resets the run history) so users can test 'run it every Thursday' scenarios; added a collapsed 'Add details' filter drawer with Classification, Include/Exclude Group, and ANY/ALL Qualifier sections that narrow the predicted call order live.

Capped the hover-card value width (200px) so the long 'Lists' value wraps into narrower lines instead of spanning the full card — its label no longer floats far left and now lines up with the other right-side labels (Phone, etc.).

Dashboard now supports an optional per-mock 'extraLinks' array (companion pages living beside index.html) — rendered as a labeled URL row plus a secondary button on the card. Used it to surface the Event Indicator's 'Current UI' page so the team can open it from the dashboard. Also tightened the wrapped-line spacing inside current-ui.html's hover card (Concurrent assignment / Lists) so a multi-line value reads as one grouped item.

Added a 'Current UI' companion page reproducing the live production Vector Scheduling day view (the 'before' next to the UX-2474 redesign): production topnav/toolbar/date-nav, green C SHIFT bar, near-square station/assignment cards, and the black detail hover-card. The hover-card showcases the new UX-2474 info in production styling — all uniform right-aligned rows split into up to three divider-separated sections (credential qualifiers / concurrent shift / admin metadata, each omitted when empty): credential status with index-matching icons (expired = red ✕ circle, expiring = yellow ⚠ triangle, missing = red dashed ? — icon inside the credential-colored badge), the concurrent shift (flag + type, then assignment name with its time on one line beneath), then Work type / Last modified by / On / Last update / Recurrence start / Covering For / Lists / Phone. Schedule-row qualifier badges match the index (colored badge + status icon) and sit above the name with the orange concurrent flag inline before the name; hover badge sizing matches the row badge exactly.

Expanded the concurrent-shift flag in the staff card's detail drawer to show the other shift the employee is scheduled on at the same time — its type plus the assignment and time — instead of just the type label. Added data-concurrent-assignment/data-concurrent-time to the five flagged cards.

Added stable ids (rule-builder, rule-builder-chat, rule-builder-config) to the dual-screen builder's containers so feedback comment-widget pins anchor reliably on this React view instead of drifting/breaking when the screen remounts.

Pinned the 'Who accepts' picker + Run callback button to the bottom of the screen in embedded Preview Mode (added a flex spacer so the bar no longer slides down as callback-chain steps accumulate). Replaced the native 'Who accepts' <select> with a custom WhoAcceptsSelect dropdown that opens upward over the chain, so its options stay visible above the bottom-pinned trigger.

In embedded Preview Mode, removed the standalone 'Predicted call order' roster (it's now redundant with the Preview Ranking / Rule Summary box on that page) and made that box's Preview Ranking list reflect the live simulation instead of the static rule preview: rows re-order as callbacks are accepted, accrued hours roll into each total, ineligible people (PTO/sick/on-shift) gray out, and whoever the simulation just granted hours to shows a green '+Nh' badge. The full-page standalone simulator keeps its original roster (scoped the removal with `!panelOnly`). PreviewRankingList/RuleSummary now take an optional `ranking` prop.

Moved the live Preview Ranking / Rule Summary box out of the rule builder's config panel — it now appears only when Preview Mode opens (it was already rendered inside the embedded simulator). The builder's sticky header is reduced to just the skipped-questions 'revisit before saving' nudge, and the top-ranked 'Next' employee pill stays in the panel header. Removed the now-unused stickyOpen state and its scroll-collapse listener.

While adding a new rule (the dual split-screen builder view), the outer navbar and the top heading header bar are now hidden — `{!building && <OuterSidebar/>}` and `{!building && <TopBar/>}` in the App shell (the sub-sidebar was already hidden during building). The builder's chat + config/preview panes now run full-bleed, and the chrome returns when you exit the builder.

AI search engine dashboard.description: Conversational AI search interface for the CallBack scheduling dashboard.

Event Indicator UX-2474.description: Rethinking how events are grouped and indicated on the scheduling calendar. Includes a 'Current UI' companion page (current-ui.html) reproducing the live production day view as the 'before' comparison.

Rules engine only.description: Standalone rules engine view for configuring scheduling automations and constraints.
